value.message: Note:  This form is not for creating a new instance; it is to add your existing instance for use with clone.
Enter the URL of the target instance you want to register for Instance Clone.

Click Continue to open the instance in a new tab and complete registration.
If the target instance is installed with the latest version of the Clone Admin Console, you'll be guided to setup OAuth between the instances.
Otherwise we'll use existing Basic authentication.
You need to be an oauth_admin on the target instance to complete Oauth Setup.
Please enter the Client ID you just generated on your target instance to complete registration.

Troubleshooting:

  • Ensure you have the clone_admin role on both source and target instances
  • If you're adding an instance, ensure you have the oauth_admin role on the target instance
